column5: University professor that discovered a card suit mantle. When put on, turns him a bit insane, but gives him card powers.
column17: Give an ally within reach or Vanish a "Card Shield". Can't give to an entity that has already been given a "Card Shield" this round.
column19: Attack for three times X damage with 1 Reach, where X is the amount of your Card Shields that have been destroyed this round. Stun Vanish.
column21: Once per game, if Vanish would die due to any effect, you may instead negate that effect, preventing all damage, and restore him back to full HP. Place him on a free non enemy tile atleast 2 tiles away.

column5: A gambler all his life, made a deal with a powerful devil to be the luckiest man alive. Now that devil goes arround with him, as he tries to pay his share of the deal.
column17: After your gathering phase, you may roll a six-sided die. If you do, replace all the action points gained from the highest gathering ally with the number of action points equal to the rolled number. This action points can only be used by Glove.
column19: Whenever you roll a die, you may have Glove take 3 unpreventable damage. If you do, you may reroll that die.
column21: Roll a six-sided die. If the result is less than 5, may repeat this process or attack for X damage within reach, where X is two times the number of succesful rolls during this action.

column5: Always loved cars, so after an almost fatal incident, turned himself into one. He is a transformer that can go from humanoid form to car form.
column17: Choose a direction. Driver moves through a straight line until he reaches the last free space in that line. Driver deals 2 damage to every entity he passes through in that line. *(once per round)*
column19: If Driver went two consecutive rounds without being gathered, he must be gathered. Whenever Driver is gathered, he heals for 4 HP.
column21: Driver takes 2 damage. Until the end of the round, Driver has plus 2 Attack and Move. *(once per round)*

column5: Drunken fishermen, has a metal leg. Not the best aim, maybe because he is always seeing double.
column17: Sailor may perform an extra free attack each round. All of Sailor's attack target random enemy entities that are able to be targetted.
column19: Both Sailor's and an adjacent allied entity's next attack does 1 more damage. *(once per round)*
column21: Attack for 4 damage an adjacent enemy entity. Until Sailor dies, he has only 2 Move. *(once per life)*

column5: An homeless guy who always had a knack for tingering with eletrical equipment. Tinkered with a radio that can now cast frequencies to speak with rats.
column17: Flip Squeak into a "Rat", and create another "Rat" on an adjacent free space. You may switch their positions. Your opponent does not know if you switched or not.
column19: Choose a direction. This attacks for 1 damage each entity within 2 tiles in that direction.
column21: Squeak deals double damage against unpreppared entities.

column5: Hailing from a far away land, he is one of the greatest boxers, who might be a little stranded for cash.
column17: Place this in a free tile 2 spaces away in a straight line. Then, deal 2 damage to one adjacent enemy entity, and stun this.
column19: Monkey may perform any amount of attack actions during a turn (action point cost must still be paid).
column21: If Monkey is at exactly 1 HP, his first attack action each turn is free.

column5: Not much is known about him, just that he is an artist who is infused with ink, being able to draw stuff and bring them to life. Has a pet ink crow, and part of his face is missing with ink leaking out.
column17: Attack for 1 damage within reach. If the attack hits an entity, stun that entity. *(once per round)*
column19: If you don't have a Greyson structure on the board, place one ("Ink Machine" or "Two-D-ret") on an adjacent free tile. *(once per round)*
column21: If you have a Greyson structure on the board, destroy it, and place Greyson on that tile. Heal Greyson for full.

column5: Merfolk pimp and entrepeuner, his majestic singing manages to make even the strongest willed to forfeit their control to him.
column17: Choose up to 3 enemy entities within reach. For each one, force them to move 1 tile, in a direction of your choice.
column19: Stun Trick. Choose an enemy hero. Until the end of the round, that hero counts as being yours. *(once per game)*
column21: Whenever an enemy entity that carries money is dealt damage, deal that amount of damage plus 1.

column5: A walking one man band. What can he not play?
column17: Change the current song to "Classical", "Rock" or "Jazz".  Note starts with a song of your choice. *(once per round)*

column5: Powerful shaman warrior, his spirit animal is a giant fluffy fat cat he summons to battle.
column17: Whenever this is placed on the board, if you don't have any "Cat" on the board, place a "Cat" in the closest possible tie to Claws (you choose if there are multiple option). If you do have it, heal that "Cat" for full.
column19: Every allied hero adjacent to Claws has the following action: "(1 AP) - Attach this to Claws. While attached, this can't take damage, and can't perform non special actions. Whenever this is unnattached from Claws, stun this. Anytime this could perform an action, it may unnatach from Claws, and be placed in an adjacent free tile. If Claws dies, place this on the tile he died in".
column21: If Claws' Cat is on the board, you may either swap their places and stun one of them OR remove Cat from the board and heal Claws by X, where X was the Cat's HP.

column5: Loan shark with some more hands on methods to make his loannes pay him back. Loves to throw coins at the problem.
column17: Income may spend money he carries instead of action points. If Income was gathered, an ally has Money Lover until the end of the round and give them 1 money.
column19: Give 1 money to any hero in a Money tile. Then, Income may perform a move action for free. For the rest of the round, allied entities with money have +1 Attack.  *(once per round)*
column21: Whenever an enemy hero kills an allied hero with X money, that enemy hero takes X damage

column5: Her favorite place? The snowy mountains, where she can slide down as much as she wants.
column17: Heal an allied entity within reach or herself by 4. *(once per round)*
column19: Until the end of the round, an allied entity within reach becomes a "Snowman". *(once per round)*
column21: Move Hail up to 4 spaces in a straight line. She may pass through up to one entity. If she does, stun that entity. If she ended in your start zone, gain 1 action point. *(once per round)*

column5: Treefolk man who shoots acorns from a wooden machinegun. The machine gun has a crank he spins.
column17: Oak cannot be forced to move by any effect of an enemy entity and cannot be passed through by any enemy entity.
column19: Whenever another entity performs a move, Oak may perform a free attack. Oak cannot have his attack stat increased over 1.
column21: Until the end of the round, Oak's base attack stat is 2. *(once per round)*

column5: The employee of the most cursed shop in the city. They sell everything from bottled horros beyond our comprehension to non euclidean geometry to eldtrich pets.
column17: If this was gathered, choose 2 tiles that are not adjacent to other 6 barrier tiles. Until the end of the round, those tiles are adjacent.
column19: Heal an allied entity within reach for X damage, where X is the amount of action points spent on this action plus 1. This action costs 1 more action point for every Monkey Oil action you have used this round.
column21: Force any allied entity to perform a move, even if it is unpreppared. Clark may perform this action even if unpreppared. *(once per turn)*

column5: He is a hunter. He has a sniper rifle. He almost always hits his shots.
column17: Bullseye can't attack through allied entities. Bullseye can attack through enemy entities.
column19: Choose a direction. Until the end of the round, the next time an enemy entity enters a tile within reach in that direction, Bullseye immediatelly attacks it for 6 damage. Until the end of the round, Bullseye cannot perform any other action.
column21: Bullseye attacks for 2 damage an adjacent enemy entity. Move it 1 tile away from Bullseye and move Bullseye 1 tile away from it. Stun Bullseye.

column5: Smoked so much all his life, now can't life without it.
column17: Create a "Smoke" in an adjacent spot or this spot. If you have more three or more "Smokes" on the board, remove one by one until you have only two.
column19: Remove all your "Smokes" from the board. Until the end of the round, Cigar's attacks deal 1 more damage for every "Smoke" removed this way.
column21: If an effect would make Cigar unpreppared, keep Cigar preppared (the rest of the effect will still apply). At the end of the round, Cigar takes 1 unpreventable damage.

column5: lizard man politician with split personality
